title: Siman 441
section: The Virtue of Hisbodidus — Secluded Personal Prayer

segments.he: הִתִּיר עַצְמוֹ הַסּוּס וּבָרַח לִמְקוֹמוֹ לְבֵית חוֹתְנוֹ.
segments.en: (5.) Rabbainu o.b.m. commanded one person that he should have hisbodidus once during the day and once at night. Once Rabbainu o.b.m. asked one of his people whether he is accustomed to groaning and sighing — called krechtzn — during hisbodidus. And he replied: "Yes." And he asked him further whether he groans and sighs from the depths of the heart. He answered and said to him: "When I make a groan and a sigh — then if I..."
